decoration: minimal — one or two subtle shapes
hero_layout: scattered — name, title, links placed around the viewport freely
hero_headline_scale: mixed — huge first name, smaller subtitle underneath
hero_height: auto — natural content height, no forced height
nav_style: fixed top bar — always visible on scroll
scroll_animation: minimal — subtle fade-up on sections (CSS only, short delay)
contact_style: big bold email as hero text
spacing_density: tight — compact, lots of content visible
quirk: project cards are arranged in a diagonal / staggered grid
bonus_quirk: the daily regen banner is styled as a handwritten note
